title: Scale as camera
fits: A hero that should feel like travel: the scroll grows a framed scene past the screen while near layers outrun far ones, so one scale reads as the camera moving in.
wrongFor: Text the visitor must read while scrolling, or a page that needs plain native scroll; the wheel is smoothed and the hero holds the screen for 1800 px of scroll.
feel: At rest until you scroll. Each wheel tick glides about 0.73 s and lands on an exponential settle, with no overshoot or bounce. Three planes at three rates read as one camera move: the type scales 1 to 8, the cabin 1 to 6.5, and the sky only drifts up at half speed.

cabin.draw: paintCabin() into #wall, #mold, #ring and #shadow, with the shade as #panel and #rail; the window opening stays clear so #sky shows through

sky.draw: paintSky(), paintStrip() and paintWisps() into #sky, behind the cabin; it rises with the scroll and never scales

wordmark.draw: #logo: plain text, from the middle of the window to the header slot over the zoom

faults.name: linear
faults.replace: cur += Math.sign(target - cur) * Math.min(Math.abs(target - cur), 1.2 * dt);

faults.name: no time-step cap
